_meta.purpose: Image-identification catalogue. Records how each photographed dish was identified, on what evidence, and whether it can be matched to a real menu item, so that no photograph reaches the website carrying a guessed dish name.
_meta.relationship: This file is the machine-readable copy the review page renders. docs/05-image-identification.md is the authored record of the same batch. tools/verify-photo-records.py fails the build if the two disagree, or if any record cites a dish or price that is not in src/data/menu.json.
_meta.confidenceRule: Confidence describes the strength of the identification only. It is never raised to make a result look more complete, and a probable match is never presented as a verified one.

batches.receivedVia: Uploaded in chat, four images, upload order preserved
batches.menuAvailable: src/data/menu.json — 157 items across 13 categories, transcribed verbatim from the restaurant's own published menu page
batches.fileAccessNote: The images arrived as paths on the reviewer's own computer. This environment could not open them as files, so analysis was performed on the images as rendered in the conversation. No file was opened, saved, renamed, moved, compressed or modified, and the suggested filenames below are records rather than actions.
batches.photosWithheldReason: These are third-party Google Maps review photographs attributed to named members of the public. The copyright sits with the photographers and the restaurant has no licence to reuse them. They are evidence for identification and must not be published on the restaurant's website.

duplicateFindings.relation: Probably the same photograph as two images from the previous batch (paste-1792096533298-22776.png and paste-1792096534668-22776.png), which were themselves identical to each other.
duplicateFindings.basis: Visual comparison of the frames as rendered: composition, reviewer attribution, plateware and chutney bowl all match, and the paste timestamps sit about three seconds apart.
duplicateFindings.caveat: This is a visual comparison, not a byte comparison — the files could not be read here. If confirmed, the dish keeps a single identity while each file keeps its own image record.
duplicateFindings.actionTaken: Reported only. No file was deleted, moved or renamed.

limitations: No file-level access to the images. They were supplied as paths on the reviewer's own computer, which this environment cannot open. Analysis was performed on the images as rendered in the conversation, and no file was saved, renamed or modified.

The link between these photographs and the restaurant is contextual, not established by the reviewer. The menu matching above is therefore against the menu held in this repository and is marked conservative.
These photographs cannot be published. They are third-party review images with named photographers.
No web lookup was used to confirm dish names for this batch, so no external name verification was performed.
